name: CampaignMap_PickExit
notes: Name from module-scoped external symbols; exact boundary from the verified overlay split. Chooses which exit to take from the current location. It forms the 66-byte record for gCampaignMap_Location in gCampaignMap_aLocationTable and an exit array at record plus 18 of four 12-byte entries. For locations 10 and above it first checks func_8002CCA8 with 71 and bit 0x20 of D_800AB398; when both hold it writes 24 to D_80169608 calls func_8003FEE0 with 48 and returns 0. When bits 0xC0 of D_800AB398 are set it treats the record as blocked unless the u16 at the record start is non-zero and func_8002CCA8 of the first exit's u16 returns zero; a blocked record returns the byte at record plus 0x10 after writing 24 and calling func_8003FEE0 with 48 or else calls func_8003FEE0 with 48 and returns the location or-ed with 0x8000. Otherwise it scans the four exits: an entry whose byte at +9 is 16 is skipped; an entry whose u16 at +0 is non-zero must pass func_8002CCA8; and the entry is taken when the u16 at +6 shares a bit with D_800AB3A4 in which case the byte at +0xA goes to D_80169608 func_8003FEE0 is called with 6 and the byte at +9 is returned. Exhausting the four returns -1. First candidate builds 110 instructions against 112 with the first 21 byte-identical including the whole prologue and the location-record arithmetic. Not yet identified: the two missing instructions. Note that the target walks two pointers through the exit array twelve bytes apart - one at the entry base for the u16 at +0 and the bytes at +9 and +0xA and one at base plus 6 for the u16 at +0 and the byte at +3 - which is the split-pointer shape rather than one struct pointer.
